name: bltn
description: Church bulletin software: one weekly workflow produces print-ready bulletins, digital bulletins, email newsletters, SMS broadcasts, social posts and signup forms (company-stated). It's made by two brothers and has run since 2014. Bootstrapped, US. TrustMRR lists ~3.5M estimated users (founder-stated).

mentions.evidence: ~$2,948 L30 (−0.5%), ~$9,157 last 3 months, ~$39,585 last 12 months, ~$247,036 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 8, 2026 ~10:07 Warsaw (08:07 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Polish parishes publish weekly "ogłoszenia parafialne" and intentions on paper, the website and Facebook. A tool that does one weekly entry → printable A4 + website page + newsletter + SMS, at ~49 zł/month per parish, has thousands of potential customers and no modern competitor I know of.

whyItPrints: Every church publishes the same announcements every week across paper, email and screens, usually by copy-paste. It has made a steady ~$3k a month for years (monthly totals of ~$2.9k–$3.8k over the last 12 months). Note: Stripe shows only 2 active subscriptions and $38 MRR, so most billing evidently runs outside Stripe subscriptions, e.g. invoices or one-off charges (my inference).
